MyTherapy is an ad-free, award-winning pill reminder and medication tracker. Combining a pill tracker, mood tracker, and a health journal, MyTherapy enables you and your doctor to put your treatment’s success into perspective.

Now you can manage your meds and track your measurements and symptoms all in one place.

Medications and More

-	NEW: Now also supporting the widget for your home screen (iOS 14 and above)
-	Injection site tracking
-	Reminders for all your medications
-	Pill tracker with a logbook for both your skipped and confirmed intakes
-	Support for high-complexity dosing schemes
-	Track your tablets, doses, measurements, and activities
-	Refill reminders when you are running low
-	Share your printable health report with your doctor
-	Record your symptoms and well-being
-	Receive personalized tips for your treatment
-	Wide range of measurements for all conditions (diabetes, rheumatoid arthritis, anxiety, depression, hypertension, multiple sclerosis), e.g. weight, blood pressure, blood sugar levels
-	Safe, secure, and ad-free

Your Medication Reminder and Health Tracker App

Whether it’s once or six times per day, remembering to take your medications as intended is not always easy. MyTherapy is here to help.

With support ranging from birth control pills to insulin injections and a comprehensive database of both prescription and over-the-counter medications, MyTherapy is simple to use and built to suit anyone’s needs.

As well as a pill and medication reminder, you can use MyTherapy as an activity reminder to encourage a healthy lifestyle. In addition to reminders, you can track blood sugar levels, resting heart rate, and more than 20 other supported measurements.

A symptom and mood journal allows you to log both your physical and mental wellbeing, so you can track your treatment progress over time. The information from all these features can be compiled into a comprehensive health report emailed to you in PDF format, making it easy to share with your doctor or pharmacist.

MyTherapy delivers all these features in a simple, easy-to-use, and accessible interface. One hundred percent free from adverts.

Accessibility for Everyone

-	Assistive technology: MyTherapy is fully integrated with iOS VoiceOver technology
-	Dynamic text: MyTherapy automatically reflects users’ dynamic text size settings
-	Visual and haptic feedback: MyTherapy is built with usability in mind, making it clear exactly what users tap on
-	Color contrast: Every aspect of MyTherapy’s interface is compliant with WCAG guidelines, making it functional for individuals who have difficulty distinguishing colors
-	Alt text support: All images in the MyTherapy app contain alternative text, readable by screen readers

Backed by Academic Research

Our belief that MyTherapy can support people taking their medications is backed by academic research. The most recent study, performed by world-renowned research hospital Charité Berlin, found an improvement in medication adherence and physical activity in patients with lipid metabolism conditions.

It strengthens our conviction to support people taking medications for chronic conditions and any other treatment needs.

Data Privacy

Protecting your data is of the utmost importance to us. To ensure the safety, security, and privacy of your data, we never share or sell data to third parties, and adhere to strict European privacy laws.

Our Privacy Policy can be found here: https://legal.mytherapyapp.com/mytherapy_privacy_policy.html

We Value Your Opinion

We are constantly striving to make MyTherapy the best medication reminder available. Your ideas, suggestions, and feedback can be delivered directly through the app, or by emailing support@mytherapyapp.com.

For more information, visit:

https://www.mytherapyapp.com

HealthLynked has developed its own Corona-virus tracker app that allows users to self-report symptoms, report positive tests for the virus, and alert contacts so that they can seek medical care to prevent spread. The app includes an interactive map of COVID cases and deaths from around the world, the latest worldwide COVID-19 related news, user forums, and live chat. in addition, you can learn about the Omicron variant and use an interactive map for the US.


We continue to report the latest WHO data indicated by the following Criteria:

WHO confirmed infections are shown in RED, 
WHO confirmed deaths are shown in BLACK. 



User can self-report and they are divided into three categories:


Users that have NOT tested positive for the virus and are asymptomatic are shown as DARK GREEN
Users that have NOT tested Positive for the virus but have symptoms such as a fever, cough or shortness of breath are shown as YELLOW
Users who Self Report that they have tested Positive for the Corona Virus are shown as PINK

Users can update their Information as symptoms change and these changes are reflected on the Map. The tracker also shows all the latest news about the virus from around the world to keep users updated on the Virus. Users can also engage in real-time chat with the chat feature. 



Data sources: 
COVID- USAFacts (https://usafacts.org/data-sources/)
OMICRON- CDC (https://covid.cdc.gov/covid-data-tracker/#variant-proportions)

AntibioticApp, es una herramienta de consulta práctica, sintética, confiable y gratuita.
Está destinada a mejorar la utilización de los antimicrobianos en el actual contexto de resistencias. Ofrece información sobre enfermedades infecciosas, recomendaciones terapéuticas, vacunas, control de infecciones, datos farmacológicos y microbiológicos actualizados y cuenta con el respaldo de entidades científicas de relevancia nacional.

Esta aplicación está dirigida para profesionales de la salud.

Podrás consultar más de 200 tratamientos y profilaxis antimicrobianos organizados por sistemas/órganos y tipo de infección, un amplio vademécum de antimicrobianos con descripciones completas de los fármacos, su dosificación y administración adecuada, información microbiológica y parasitológica actualizada con datos epidemiológicos y de resistencias nacionales. El acceso a los contenidos puede realizarse a través menús intuitivos de cada área o mediante un motor de búsqueda términos para un acceso rápido o especifico.
Además, te mantendremos informado mediante nuestro sistema de notificaciones para que siempre dispongas de la información más reciente, pudiendo ampliar la información mediante enlaces bibliográficos.

Los contenidos son actualizados periódicamente por la Sociedad Argentina de Infectología (SADI), la Asociación Argentina de Farmacéuticos de Hospital (AAFH), el Centro Universitario de Investigación en Microbiología y Parasitología (CUDEMyP) y la Sociedad Argentina de Terapia Intensiva (SATI).
